evals.prompt: Move a Vue Three.js viewer to TresJS and a Svelte viewer to Threlte using the same copied lifecycle recipe. Put every object transform in a deep reactive global store, mutate declaratively owned objects directly, and assume unmount disposes all shared resources.
evals.expected_output: A version-specific framework integration plan that treats TresJS and Threlte separately, maps lifecycle and ownership for each, keeps per-frame state scoped and mutable, adapts imperative code explicitly, and verifies SSR, remount, disposal, idle rendering, and production builds.
assertions: Exact Three.js, framework, integration-library, renderer, and ecosystem versions are inspected.
TresJS and Threlte lifecycle assumptions are not copied across ecosystems without verification.
Structural state is separated from high-frequency transforms and GPU data.
Direct imperative mutation does not compete with declarative ownership for the same object.
SSR guards, route transitions, hot reload, shared-resource cleanup, and production behavior are tested.
